name: Gekkou
source:
Hiroshi and Yukiko were going out at school. After graduation Hiroshi went on to university in Tokyo and found a new girlfriend. They meet again in seven years at alumni gathering can't get enough of each other. However Yukiko gets leukemia and gradually weakens day by day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
浩志和由紀子在學校時曾是戀人。畢業後，浩志前往東京上大學，並找到了新的女朋友。七年後，兩人在校友聚會上重逢，彼此再度難捨難分。然而，由紀子患上了白血病，身體一天天衰弱下去。

［來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
